note: Kalkaska County zoning is published only as a static 2016 PDF district map (county planning page); Garfield, Kalkaska and Blue Lake townships and the Village of Kalkaska administer their own zoning, with zoning maps only as PDF or image files. The county GIS (colligogis.com) is a login-gated parcel viewer with no public zoning service. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches found no queryable Kalkaska zoning district layer.
